summary:
Unbounded tile counts in ff_dxva2_hevc_fill_picture_parameters()
(libavcodec/dxva2_hevc.c, shared with d3d12va_hevc.c). DXVA2 and D3D12VA
are Windows-only hwaccels (configure: dxva2_deps="dxva2api_h ... ole32
user32", d3d12va_deps="dxva_h ID3D12Device ..."), so they are never
enabled in our Linux build.
Refs:
  - https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-125239
  - https://code.ffmpeg.org/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/296720a7be44fe03569e13e57ea7899cb77f3895
